name: hero-walk-eight-directions
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for the Gouden Horizon game.
Primary request: Generate ONE premium painterly 2.5D eight-direction FULL BODY hero walking atlas, genuinely transparent background.
Input image: the supplied image is a character and painting-style reference only. Create new directional walking frames, do not reproduce the reference layout or its artifacts.
Subject identity: same young auburn-haired climate explorer with swept tousled reddish brown hair, teal long coat, ochre scarf, leather backpack with rolled bedroll, brown trousers and leather boots, brass staff with a luminous cyan globe. Keep identical proportions, face, costume, backpack, materials and colors throughout. Staff always stays in the character's anatomical RIGHT hand, including back views.
Composition: portrait canvas ideally 1536 by 2048 or 2048 by 3072. Exact regular grid of 8 rows and 6 columns, 48 individual cutout full-body sprites total. Every sprite has same scale and feet anchor relative to its cell, entire body and staff inside cell with at least 12 percent clear safety padding. No touching or overlapping adjacent cells.
Row directions top to bottom: 1 SOUTH facing toward camera; 2 SOUTHWEST; 3 WEST profile looking left; 4 NORTHWEST; 5 NORTH away from camera showing backpack; 6 NORTHEAST; 7 EAST profile looking right; 8 SOUTHEAST. Camera is elevated 2.5D view, fixed light and fixed camera elevation.
Each row is one six-frame looping WALKING cycle progressing LEFT TO RIGHT: left foot contact, left leg down weight-bearing, passing pose, right foot contact, right leg down weight-bearing, opposite passing pose. Make a convincing locomotion cycle with coherent knee bending, correct feet, shoulder/pelvis weight transfer, arm counter-swing, coat and scarf lag. Neutral focused expression, moderate walking stride, no attack or victory poses. Staff is carried in the same right hand throughout with a small consistent sway.
Style: beautifully painted fantasy adventure game character, rich material detail, clean legible silhouette, restrained edge highlights, cohesive teal/ochre/brass/cyan palette matching reference.
Transparency: true alpha in ALL non-character pixels. No floor, cast shadow, grounding circle, colored backing, checkerboard baked into image, chroma key, red or magenta bars, visible cell borders, gridlines, text, letters, direction labels, numbers, logos or watermarks. Empty gaps are fully transparent. Preserve genuine alpha.
integration: Original RGBA preserved as lossless WebP. Crops and runtime silhouette clipping use actual sprite extents. Hero directions reordered after visual review; 48 frames retain shared scale and per-frame foot anchors.

name: enemy-roles-atlas
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: enemy sprite atlas for the Gouden Horizon game.
Primary request: ONE square transparent 2 by 2 regular-grid atlas containing four distinct premium painterly 2.5D enemy full-body sprites. Ideal canvas 2048 by 2048.
Reference: supplied hero walking atlas is a PAINTING STYLE reference only; use its rich tactile painted material detail, lighting, slight elevated camera view and dimensional fantasy adventure game treatment. Do not copy the human hero.
Exact layout:
TOP LEFT: Boogjager — agile long-bodied electric marsh predator. A fast runner silhouette with narrow stretched torso, strong springing hind legs, sleek head, expressive cyan fins along back and tail, small contained cyan electrical arcs. Lean low stalking sprint-ready posture, reptile/amphibian anatomy, all limbs readable.
TOP RIGHT: Asgraver — low heavy armored ember salamander burrowing creature. Thick digging forelimbs, very broad squat silhouette, layered ochre scales and molten orange cracks between plates, blunt stone-breaking face. Weighty grounded stance with armored tail, all limbs readable.
BOTTOM LEFT: Schildrover — human scavenger in worn teal riot armor. Huge asymmetric shield made of salvaged metal plates, rivets, dents and brass hardware held on one side; brass shock baton held in other hand. Threatening full-body stance, brown boots, practical cloth layers, shield does not hide the whole figure.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Stormnest — stationary swollen violet storm organism inside a broken industrial turbine. Violet fleshy storm sac seated in rust-and-teal turbine housing, cyan electrical pods, short contained cyan arcs, wide rooted base with organic tendrils anchored to turbine feet. Compact broad stationary silhouette.
Composition/framing: four isolated cutout subjects, one centered in each equal square cell. Same slight elevated 2.5D camera angle, consistent soft key lighting. Large readable silhouettes with distinct heights and masses. All limbs, tails, fins, weapons, shields, arcs and turbine parts stay inside their own cell with at least 12 percent clear safety padding on EVERY edge. No overlap/contact across cell gaps. Full-body sprites; none cropped.
Style: premium hand-painted adventure-game artwork with real texture and depth, refined edges, believable weight, dramatic but readable shape design, teal/brass/ochre/cyan industrial ecology palette; violet only for Stormnest.
Transparency: genuine alpha background, every non-subject pixel transparent, including spaces between all cells. No text, names, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, grids, borders, floor, cast shadows, grounding circles, scenery, backing colors or baked-in checkerboard.
integration: Original RGBA preserved as lossless WebP. Crops and runtime silhouette clipping use actual sprite extents. Hero directions reordered after visual review; 48 frames retain shared scale and per-frame foot anchors.

name: regional-boss-atlas
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: regional-boss sprite atlas for the Gouden Horizon game.
Primary request: ONE landscape transparent 3 by 2 regular-grid atlas containing three unique huge regional bosses in two poses each. Ideal canvas 3072 by 2048.
Reference: supplied hero walking atlas is a PAINTING STYLE reference only; use its rich tactile painted material detail, lighting, slight elevated camera view and dimensional fantasy adventure game treatment. Do not copy the human hero.
Exact grid: three columns and two rows. TOP row calm threatening ready stance. BOTTOM row clear expressive windup attack pose of the EXACT SAME subject in the corresponding column. Same costume, body, colors, size and rendering across the two poses of each boss. Weapons and limbs must be fully visible within cells.
LEFT COLUMN: Getijdenmaaier — colossal rust-and-teal tidal dredging mech supported by FOUR massive articulated crawler legs. Heavy hydraulic claw arm, visible hydraulic pistons and battered maritime steel, luminous cyan pump core in central body. TOP: heavy stable four-leg ready stance, claw lowered. BOTTOM: claw drawn high and back preparing a crushing sweep, body leans and braces on all four legs, clear stored force and weight transfer.
MIDDLE COLUMN: Spiegelvorst — golden solar-mirror armored knight sentinel. Huge prism shield and long sun lance, faceted gold armor reflecting pale solar highlights, dark teal cloth. TOP: imposing defensive ready stance with shield and lance. BOTTOM: deep planted attack windup, prism shield braced and sun lance cocked far backward for a powerful forward thrust; cloth responds to motion. Same shield, lance, armor and anatomical handedness across poses.
RIGHT COLUMN: Kiemhart — towering ancient mangrove/tree symbiosis with greenhouse-machine parts. Thick trunk torso and root legs, visible glowing green seed core, greenhouse glass and brass machinery integrated into trunk, two immense branch arms, readable massive tree crown with broad canopy. TOP: solemn looming stance. BOTTOM: branch arms raised and twisted to wind up a huge sweeping slam, trunk torsion and roots braced; keep crown and all branches within frame.
Composition/framing: six isolated FULL-BODY cutout bosses, each centered in its equal cell. Fixed slight elevated 2.5D camera angle and fixed light. Same scale and ground anchor for top/bottom pose of each boss. Massive readable silhouettes and real body weight. All bodies, crawler legs, roots, claws, lance, shield, crown, branches and visual effects stay inside their own cell with at least 12 percent clear safety padding on EVERY edge. No overlap/contact across cells. None cropped.
Style: premium hand-painted fantasy adventure-game artwork with rich material texture, depth and purposeful silhouettes; rust, teal, brass, gold, cyan and green; expressive threatening anticipation poses.
Transparency: genuine alpha background, all empty pixels transparent, including spaces between every cell. No text, names, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, grids, borders, floor, cast shadows, grounding circles, scenery, backing colors or baked-in checkerboard.
integration: Original RGBA preserved as lossless WebP. Crops and runtime silhouette clipping use actual sprite extents. Hero directions reordered after visual review; 48 frames retain shared scale and per-frame foot anchors.
